author: emilygraceillustration
title: Storyboard Artist Wanted for Animatic
content:
STORYBOARD ARTIST WANTED! 🎬

I'm looking for a talented freelance storyboard artist to collaborate on a short proof-of-concept animatic for an original animated action-adventure series.

I'm particularly keen to hear from artists who specialise in dynamic action sequences, cinematic composition and strong character moments.

This is a paid opportunity for a small, creator-led project.

If you're interested, or know someone who might be a great fit, please get in touch or tag them below. Please share your portfolio/reel and rates via DM.

Thanks!

author: dimension11studios
title: Hiring Character Artist for Game Project
content:
WE'RE HIRING!🎨

We're looking for a Character Artist to join the team working on Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water.

If you're skilled in 3D character modelling, sculpting, texturing, and Unreal Engine, this could be a great fit!

Experience with MetaHuman, realistic 4C hair, African hairstyles, and character materials is a big plus.

📍 Remote
🤝 Long-term collaboration
